65. Consider the following statements regarding
ocean currents:
A. The Gulf Stream is a warm ocean current
flowing along the eastern coast of North
America into the North Atlantic.
B. The Humboldt (Peru) Current is a cold
ocean current flowing northwards along the
western coast of South America.
C. The Benguela Current is a warm current
flowing along the eastern coast of Australia.
D. Cold ocean currents generally flow from polar
regions toward lower equatorial latitudes.

questions.explanation_english:
The Gulf Stream is a warm North Atlantic
ocean current, the Humboldt Current is a cold
current along South America’s west coast, and
cold ocean currents generally flow from high
polar latitudes toward the equator. However, the
Benguela Current is a cold current flowing along
the southwestern coast of Africa, not Australia.

correct, while statement C misidentifies current
characteristics.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। गल्फ स्ट्रीम एक गर्म उत्तरी अटलांटिक महासागरीय धारा है, हंबोल्ट धारा दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट के साथ एक ठंडी धारा है, और ठंडी महासागरीय धाराएँ सामान्यतः उच्च ध्रुवीय अक्षांशों से समतापीय की ओर बहती हैं। हालाँकि, बेंगुएला धारा एक ठंडी धारा है जो अफ्रीका के दक्षिण-पश्चिमी तट के साथ बहती है, न कि ऑस्ट्रेलिया के साथ। इसलिए, कथन A, B, और D सही हैं, जबकि कथन C धारा की विशेषताओं को गलत पहचानता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A, B and D only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Gulf Stream is a warm North Atlantic ocean current, the Humboldt Current is a cold current along South America’s west coast, and cold ocean currents generally flow from high polar latitudes toward the equator.
